name: Selco Products Company
old_description: Since 1958, Selco Products has served a wide variety of markets on a strong yet simple foundation of personal service. With corporate headquarters in Reno, Nevada, our sales force consists of direct and manufacturer representatives and authorized distributors throughout North America and Mexico.
about:
Founded in 1958 in Reno, Nevada, Selco Products began as a family-owned business built on personal service in the temperature control market. The company maintains its corporate headquarters in Reno and operates a sales network of direct representatives and authorized distributors across North America and Mexico.

Selco designs and manufactures a broad line of temperature controls, including disc thermostats, remote capillary controls, probe thermostats, NTC thermistors with interchangeable accuracies of ±0.05°C to ±1.0°C, electronic temperature controls, thermal protectors, digital panel meters, and custom wire harness assemblies. Manufacturing capabilities span mechanical engineering, probe design, PCB layout (AutoCAD, SolidWorks), SMT pick-and-place (Juki), convection reflow (Lovell), wave soldering, epoxy potting, and wire cutting, stripping, and crimping. Production runs from prototypes to full volume, supported by a Reno facility and exclusive manufacturing partnerships in Brazil, China, Italy, Mexico, Japan, and Taiwan.

The company serves HVAC, medical, electronics, professional audio, industrial instrumentation, power supply, food service, appliances, process controls, telecommunications, aerospace, and laboratory markets. Customers include foodservice equipment makers such as Proluxe and AJ Antunes, ice machine manufacturer Ice-O-Matic, compressor supplier VMAC, and a German freezestat producer that transitioned four models to Selco. Distributors handle small-quantity and repair orders.

Selco’s stated mission is to manufacture and supply quality, innovative thermal management products with outstanding worldwide service. Differentiators cited include an ISO 9001:2015 quality system, just-in-time and Kanban inventory programs, same-day shipping from Reno for stocked parts, engineering support with thermal testing and failure analysis, a one-year warranty, and free samples in most cases.
